annotations.title: Get an API key for this agent

description: Issue this agent its own ZeroDust API key for higher rate limits, with no human signup step. The other tools work without a key, so only call this when rate limits are being hit, or when setting up an unattended agent that will run repeatedly. The key is returned once and cannot be retrieved later - report it to the operator.
